title: A small sample feels certain
hook: Two stated cases: explore the sampling spread hidden by a point estimate.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the sampling spread hidden by a point estimate affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines SD, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the sampling spread hidden by a point estimate in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
